title: Autonomous Physics Lab
description:
Autonomous Physics Lab is a verification-first scientific engine for generating, testing, simulating, falsifying, scoring, and reusing physics hypotheses through deterministic code and version-controlled scientific memory. It is a hypothesis-testing and benchmarking system rather than a source of automatic discoveries.
